Comprehensive rewrite: added tool summary table, JSON examples for every tool, parameter tables, common workflow patterns, error handling reference, best practices, and See Also links
Updated skill name for better discoverability

Initial release of Reepl LinkedIn management skill.

- Manage LinkedIn drafts, posts, scheduling, contacts, collections, and templates directly through Reepl.
- Generate AI images for LinkedIn posts with multiple styles.
- Maintain and reference a personalized voice profile for consistent content creation.
- All LinkedIn posts must use plain text (no markdown formatting).
- User authentication via Reepl account and API key required.
- Built-in safeguards: always confirm before publishing or scheduling posts, and display AI-generated images for approval.
